name: Supabase (Auth + Postgres + RLS)
description: Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) policy auditing, declarative migrations, and local Supabase CLI workflow.
verification_commands: supabase start  # ensure local Supabase stack is running before DB and RLS verification
supabase db reset  # replay migrations cleanly and verify idempotent schema and RLS baseline
supabase test db  # run pgTAP Row-Level Security and database policy tests

evaluators.name: Supabase Auth & PostgreSQL RLS Security Evaluator
evaluators.scope: RLS enabled on every exposed table, least-privilege anon/authenticated policies, auth.uid() and JWT claim verification, server-only service_role key isolation, and migration/seed safety.

single_concurrency_locks: Local Supabase Stack: Only 1 subagent at a time may run `supabase start`, `supabase stop`, `supabase db reset`, or `supabase test db` to prevent local Docker container and port collisions.
pr_checklist: Every table in `public` (and exposed schemas) enables `ROW LEVEL SECURITY` with explicit per-command policies audited against `data-supabase`
Migrations replay cleanly via `supabase db reset` and RLS tests (`supabase test db` or integration suite) verify cross-tenant and anonymous access denial
agents_md_rules: **Supabase Auth & RLS:** Follow [`.agents/skills/data-supabase/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/data-supabase/SKILL.md) (RLS enabled on every exposed table, `service_role` server-only, verify via `supabase db reset` and RLS tests).
